title: Note 1
text:
ADSASDThe dialog is too short for its content — the save button gets pushed out. The text box is `expand=True` and eats all the space. Fix is to give the dialog more height and stop the text box from expanding greedily.

Fixed. The problem was `fill="both", expand=True` on the text frame — it consumed all remaining vertical space, leaving nothing for the button. Now:

- text box uses a fixed `height=6` lines with `fill="x"` only
- dialog auto-sizes to fit all content via `pack` without a hardcoded geometry
- `resizable(False, False)` so users can't accidentally break the layout again
